item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the mandatory statutory national-interest determination authorizing the drawdown of specified defense assistance for Colombia; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment itself.","evidence":"I hereby determine that it is in the national interest of the United States to drawdown defense articles"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently directs and authorizes the drawdown of up to $7 million in specified defense articles, services, and training; any later delivery is ministerial implementation of this immediate legally consequential act.","evidence":"I hereby direct the drawdown of up to $7 million of such defense articles"}]}
